Hi Vivek,

We submitted payment for Redwood invoices 45211 (GBP 18,240.00) and 45212 (GBP 2,760.00) yesterday but the bank processed them as two separate credits from different accounts.

Summary: 
- Transfer A (cleared 25-Nov, 07:05 GMT): GBP 18,240.00 — references: "CPAY-45211" — VAT line included on remittance.
- Transfer B (cleared 25-Nov, 07:18 GMT): GBP 2,760.00 — references: "CPAY-45212_PART" — VAT line absent on the bank metadata.

I've attached the remittance advice we sent ([attachment: remittance_advice_1125.pdf (PDF, 38KB)]). Bank has also provided a basic trace for both transfers but the second one doesn't show the VAT code on their end.

Could you confirm how Redwood will apply these to our account? We want the smaller payment applied to 45212 but we also need confirmation whether Redwood will accept the VAT-less transfer as full settlement or whether we should raise a credit note + top-up.

If you need a bank trace, I can request one from BankX — happy to do that asap. We'd like to close this today if possible to avoid any dunning flags.

Thanks,

Forwarding the remittance to finance for reconciliation.

Marissa here (AR) — I can see two incoming ledger hits but the smaller credit settled without a VAT descriptor; our system partially applied the amounts which left invoice 45212 marked as unpaid by VAT component.

Next steps from AR: 
- Request a bank trace for Transfer B to show the instruction line (we need MT103 or similar). Liam at BankX can produce that — Emma, can you confirm if you want us to request or if you prefer to ask BankX directly?
- If trace shows VAT was omitted on instruction, we can either: 1) accept payment against principal and issue an invoice adjustment for VAT; or 2) wait for a corrective remittance/credit from ClearPay and apply as full settlement.

Recommended path: get the bank trace first. If trace includes VAT code we will post and clear 45212. If not, we'll provisionally post principal and raise an internal adjustment. We will not send a dunning notice in the interim.

Can you provide the beneficiary account (last 4 digits) for Transfer B so I can match to the ledger entry?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
